item.title: Update CHANGELOG.md and bump version to v0.3.5
item.intent: CHANGELOG.md reflects all work completed since v0.3.4 and VERSION reads 0.3.5. Users and contributors can see exactly what changed in this release.
item.description: BUG-082 was manually marked done but the actual work was never completed — VERSION is still 0.3.4 and docs/CHANGELOG.md has no 0.3.5 section. Since v0.3.4, 20+ items were completed (BUG-067 through BUG-092, FEAT-027 through FEAT-032): refactoring, simplification, notification system, multi-backlog support, retry intelligence, category filter, --limit flag, real-time streaming, and numerous bug fixes. These constitute a patch release (v0.3.5).
steps: Add a [0.3.5] - 2026-03-21 section to docs/CHANGELOG.md with Added, Fixed, and Changed subsections covering BUG-067 through BUG-092 and FEAT-027 through FEAT-032
Run .aishore/aishore checksums to regenerate checksums after version bump
acceptanceCriteria: [0.3.5] section covers the key items completed since v0.3.4 (at minimum: notifications, streaming, multi-backlog, retry intelligence, category filter, --limit, and the major bug fixes)
